title: Module manifest
description: The manifest.json of an agent-built UI module at /modules/<name>/manifest.json (stored as module:<name>/manifest.json). The module renders in a sandboxed, network-less iframe under Modules.

name.description: Module name; must equal the /modules/<name>/ directory.

title.description: Display title in the Modules list and page header.

description.description: One or two sentences on what the module shows or does.

entry.description: Module-relative path of the entry .mjs file; its default export is mount(root, host).

libraries.description: Vendored library ids the module imports (see /modules/_catalogue.json).
